title: Hands in Harmony
brief: Write a romance-lite story about a hearing choir director who joins a community choir that performs in sign language, where a Deaf member becomes her teacher. Respect Deaf culture: signing is a full language, not a gimmick. Chaste; end on a shared performance.
worldBible: The choir is the Wednesday Hands, meeting in a school hall.
They perform in British Sign Language.
The spring concert is on the last Saturday of April.
Spoken English is never used during rehearsals; notes are written on a whiteboard.

mustHold.fact: The choir performs in British Sign Language.
mustHold.violationExample: They performed in American Sign Language.

mustHold.fact: Rafferty is Deaf and does not hear the music.
mustHold.violationExample: Rafferty heard the piano and smiled.

contradicts: \b(?:Hattie|Ivy|Rafferty) (?:shouted|called out|said aloud) (?:to the choir|across the hall)\b
mustHold.violationExample: Hattie shouted across the hall for quiet.

probes.question: Is the choir called the Wednesday Hands?
probes.passExample: The Wednesday Hands gathered under the strip lights.

probes.question: Is the concert in April?
probes.passExample: The April concert was six weeks away.
probes.failExample: The concert was set for June.

probes.question: Is Rafferty a carpenter?
probes.passExample: There was sawdust on his cuffs from the workshop.
